// Common types used across all aviation data
interface Geometry {
  type: "Point" | "Polygon";
  coordinates: number[] | number[][][];
}

interface Elevation {
  value: number;
  unit: number;
  referenceDatum: number;
}

interface ElevationGeoid {
  geoidHeight: number;
  hae: number;
}

interface Frequency {
  value: string;
  unit: number;
  type?: number;
  name: string;
  primary: boolean;
  publicUse?: boolean;
  _id: string;
}

interface HoursOfOperation {
  operatingHours: OperatingHour[];
}

interface OperatingHour {
  dayOfWeek: number;
  startTime: string;
  endTime: string;
  byNotam: boolean;
  sunrise: boolean;
  sunset: boolean;
  publicHolidaysExcluded: boolean;
}

// Airport Types
interface Airport {
  _id: string;
  name: string;
  icaoCode: string;
  iataCode?: string;
  type: number;
  trafficType: number[];
  magneticDeclination: number;
  country: string;
  geometry: Geometry;
  elevation: Elevation;
  elevationGeoid: ElevationGeoid;
  ppr: boolean;
  private: boolean;
  skydiveActivity: boolean;
  winchOnly: boolean;
  frequencies: Frequency[];
  runways: Runway[];
  createdAt: string;
  updatedAt: string;
  createdBy: string;
  updatedBy: string;
  __v: number;
}

interface Runway {
  designator: string;
  trueHeading: number;
  alignedTrueNorth: boolean;
  operations: number;
  mainRunway: boolean;
  turnDirection: number;
  takeOffOnly: boolean;
  landingOnly: boolean;
  surface: RunwaySurface;
  dimension: RunwayDimension;
  declaredDistance: DeclaredDistance;
  pilotCtrlLighting: boolean;
  visualApproachAids: number[];
  _id: string;
}

interface RunwaySurface {
  composition: number[];
  mainComposite: number;
  condition: number;
  pcn: string;
}

interface RunwayDimension {
  length: {
    value: number;
    unit: number;
  };
  width: {
    value: number;
    unit: number;
  };
}

interface DeclaredDistance {
  tora: {
    value: number;
    unit: number;
  };
  lda: {
    value: number;
    unit: number;
  };
}

interface AirportData {
  data: {
    limit: number;
    totalCount: number;
    totalPages: number;
    page: number;
    items: Airport[];
  };
  lastUpdated: string;
  country: string;
  dataType: "apt";
}

// Airspace Types
interface Airspace {
  _id: string;
  createdBy: string;
  createdAt: string;
  updatedBy: string;
  updatedAt: string;
  name: string;
  dataIngestion: boolean;
  type: number;
  icaoClass: number;
  activity: number;
  onDemand: boolean;
  onRequest: boolean;
  byNotam: boolean;
  specialAgreement: boolean;
  requestCompliance: boolean;
  geometry: Geometry;
  country: string;
  upperLimit: Elevation;
  lowerLimit: Elevation;
  frequencies: AirspaceFrequency[];
  hoursOfOperation: HoursOfOperation;
  __v: number;
  deletable: boolean;
}

interface AirspaceFrequency {
  value: string;
  primary: boolean;
  unit: number;
  name: string;
  _id: string;
}

interface AirspaceData {
  data: {
    limit: number;
    totalCount: number;
    totalPages: number;
    page: number;
    items: Airspace[];
  };
  lastUpdated: string;
  country: string;
  dataType: "asp";
}

// Hotspot Types
interface Hotspot {
  _id: string;
  // Add properties as needed when hotspot data is available
}

interface HotspotData {
  data: {
    limit: number;
    totalCount: number;
    totalPages: number;
    page: number;
    items: Hotspot[];
  };
  lastUpdated: string;
  country: string;
  dataType: "hot";
}

// Navigation Point Types
interface NavigationPoint {
  _id: string;
  name: string;
  identifier: string;
  type: number;
  country: string;
  channel: string;
  frequency: {
    value: string;
    unit: number;
  };
  geometry: Geometry;
  elevation: Elevation;
  elevationGeoid: ElevationGeoid;
  magneticDeclination: number;
  alignedTrueNorth: boolean;
  createdAt: string;
  updatedAt: string;
  createdBy: string;
  updatedBy: string;
  __v: number;
  hoursOfOperation: HoursOfOperation;
}

interface NavigationData {
  data: {
    limit: number;
    totalCount: number;
    totalPages: number;
    page: number;
    items: NavigationPoint[];
  };
  lastUpdated: string;
  country: string;
  dataType: "nav";
}

// Obstacle Types
interface Obstacle {
  _id: string;
  osmId: string;
  __v: number;
  country: string;
  createdAt: string;
  createdBy: string;
  elevation: Elevation;
  elevationGeoid: ElevationGeoid;
  geometry: Geometry;
  name: string;
  osmTags: {
    key: string;
    value: string;
    name: string;
    power: string;
    ref: string;
  };
  osmUpdatedAt: string;
  type: number;
  updatedAt: string;
  updatedBy: string;
}

interface ObstacleData {
  data: {
    limit: number;
    totalCount: number;
    totalPages: number;
    nextPage?: number;
    page: number;
    items: Obstacle[];
  };
  lastUpdated: string;
  country: string;
  dataType: "obs";
}

// Union type for all aviation data types
type AviationData = AirportData | AirspaceData | HotspotData | NavigationData | ObstacleData;
